source_title: TrendForce Says NAND Flash Market to Regain Balance in 2018 with Annual Bit Supply Growing by 42.9%
claim_relevant_visible_text: Some losses of production capacity occurred as non-Samsung suppliers strive to improve their respective 3D-NAND production processes.
researcher_paraphrase: By late September 2017, DRAMeXchange attributed part of NAND undersupply to production-capacity losses during non-Samsung suppliers’ 2D-to-3D NAND process transition.
precision_guard: This is a late-2017 methodological-primary market observation about transition-related effective capacity, not a quantified wafer-loss ledger for each supplier.
authority_boundary: TrendForce/DRAMeXchange is methodological-primary for the market observation; it is not the primary manufacturing record of the named suppliers.
